risks.title: Raw material price fluctuations
risks.summary: The company is exposed to price variations in agricultural raw materials, particularly nuts, cocoa, and dried fruits, which represent a major portion of its costs.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first section of Item 1A, with a direct impact on gross margin. Approximately 28% of nut and dried fruit purchases come from abroad. The language emphasizes the potentially significant impact on costs. Dependence on nuts, cocoa, and dried fruits strongly exposes the company to commodity volatility. High weighting for a macro risk.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.summary: The company has not hedged its exposure to variable interest rates on its credit facilities, making it sensitive to rising interest rates.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly quantified: a hypothetical 10% increase in interest rates would impact net income by $0.3 million. No hedging in place for variable-rate debt. Central position in the 10-K, but moderate impact. Medium-weighted category under Capital.

risks.title: Foreign currency cost exposure
risks.summary: Although payments are in USD, the relative value of the dollar can affect the cost of purchasing raw materials internationally.
risks.score_rationale: Although purchases are in USD, the underlying cost varies with the USD exchange rate versus local currencies (e.g., euro). Mentioned in the context of international purchases (28%). Language is cautious but not alarming. Indirect but real risk to cost competitiveness.

risks.title: SERP retirement plan obligations
risks.summary: The unfunded retirement plan (SERP) represents a significant liability sensitive to actuarial assumptions, particularly the discount rate.
risks.score_rationale: Projected benefit obligation reaches $28.7 million (Note 15). Discount rate is a critical assumption subject to judgment. Subject of a Critical Audit Matter, highlighting its importance. Potentially high impact on financial statements if assumptions are revised.

risks.title: Dependence on foreign sourcing
risks.summary: A significant portion of raw materials is imported, exposing the company to disruptions in international supply chains.
risks.score_rationale: 28% of nut purchases come from abroad, creating logistical and commercial vulnerability. Indirect risk of supply disruption or cost increases due to geopolitical or climatic factors. Mentioned in the context of raw material prices, but implies major operational exposure.

risks.title: Cocoa price volatility
risks.summary: Cocoa prices have reached record historical highs, directly impacting the company's production costs for its bars.
risks.score_rationale: Cocoa is a significant ingredient for the company's bar product line. Prices reached record levels in December 2024 and remain well above historical averages. Three consecutive years of supply deficit have created structural price tension. High risk of margin and competitiveness impact if prices do not decline rapidly.

risks.title: Import tariff impacts
risks.summary: U.S. tariffs on key raw material imports (cashews from Vietnam, pepitas/pine nuts from China) increase costs and create planning uncertainty.
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 2% of material costs (pepitas and pine nuts) are subject to 55% import tariffs from China. Cashews imported from Vietnam (majority) are subject to 20% tariffs. Tariff uncertainty makes planning difficult. Potentially material impact if tariffs are maintained or increased.

risks.title: Decline in branded product demand
risks.summary: Consumers are reducing purchases of branded nuts, dried fruit mixes, and bars due to high retail prices and economic uncertainty.
risks.score_rationale: Decline in sales volume for nuts, dried fruit mixes, and bars. Consumers are reducing purchases of branded products due to uncertain economic conditions and high retail prices. Decline observed both for the company and in the snack food industry. Significant structural risk to revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: The company JBSS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
